description: The New York Giants host the Washington Commanders in NFC East play at MetLife Stadium. New York enters with a 5-2-1 record, and Washington enters with a 2-5-1 record. The Giants and Commanders played to a 27-27 tie in October 2026.

title: Live: NFL GameDay Morning
description: Rich Eisen leads a cast of NFL talent through four hours of pregame hype, prepping viewers for the kickoffs of Sunday's games. Joining Eisen is Super Bowl champion Kurt Warner, former NFL head coach Steve Mariucci, and special guests each week to break down the matchups. The latest news from around the league, reports from game sites and interviews with players and coaches are featured, and insider Ian Rapoport provides late-breaking news.

title: NFL GameDay Live
description: Expanding on NFL Network's "GameDay" programming on Sundays during football season, "GameDay Live" updates viewers on what's happening throughout the league. Beginning with kickoff of early-afternoon events and continuing throughout late-afternoon contests, the studio show offers nearly immediate highlights of scoring and other notable plays.
